en: The image depicts a black and white photograph of a choir or music group composed of young girls and a few adults, arranged in several rows in front of a building with large windows and a wooden door. Musical instruments, such as brass horns, are displayed on a table in front of the group. The individuals are dressed in formal, old-fashioned attire typical of the late 19th or early 20th century. The caption below the image is in Dutch and refers to a choir and music group at an orphanage in Neerbosch.
